settings.body: These terms explain access, billing, customer usage, and the responsibilities of the site owner and customer.

settings.title: Terms of service
settings.body:
1. Acceptance

By using this site, you agree to these terms and to the privacy policy that governs uploads, generated outputs, purchases, and private delivery.

2. Accounts

Customers must provide accurate account information and keep credentials secure. Each account belongs to the photo workspace and cannot be shared across unrelated site customer records.

3. Subscriptions and credits

Subscriptions and one-time credit packs provide credits for AI photo generation. Credits are granted after confirmed payment, reserved when a job starts, consumed after successful delivery, and released when a job fails or times out.

4. Refunds

Unused credits may be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits already spent on successful generations are not refundable unless support confirms a service-side technical failure.

5. Uploaded content

You may only upload images and references you control or have permission to use. The site may reject, review, remove, or block content that violates law, platform rules, or safety policy.

6. Delivery

Completed jobs are delivered to the signed-in customer account. Delivery states, retries, credit releases, and refunds are handled by the backend and recorded in your credit history.

7. Liability

The service is provided as a software subscription. To the extent permitted by law, liability is limited to the fees paid for the current billing period or the affected credit purchase.

8. Contact us

Email support@mydreamshoots.com for account, billing, refund, or policy questions.

settings.title: Terms that govern customer accounts and private delivery.
settings.body: These terms explain access, billing, customer usage, and the responsibilities of the site owner and customer.

settings.title: Terms of service
settings.body:
1. Acceptance

By using this site, you agree to these terms and to the privacy policy that governs uploads, generated outputs, purchases, and private delivery.

2. Accounts

Customers must provide accurate account information and keep credentials secure. Each account belongs to the photo workspace and cannot be shared across unrelated site customer records.

3. Subscriptions and credits

Subscriptions and one-time credit packs provide credits for AI photo generation. Credits are granted after confirmed payment, reserved when a job starts, consumed after successful delivery, and released when a job fails or times out.

4. Refunds

Unused credits may be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits already spent on successful generations are not refundable unless support confirms a service-side technical failure.

5. Uploaded content

You may only upload images and references you control or have permission to use. The site may reject, review, remove, or block content that violates law, platform rules, or safety policy.

6. Delivery

Completed jobs are delivered to the signed-in customer account. Delivery states, retries, credit releases, and refunds are handled by the backend and recorded in your credit history.

7. Liability

The service is provided as a software subscription. To the extent permitted by law, liability is limited to the fees paid for the current billing period or the affected credit purchase.

8. Contact us

Email support@mydreamshoots.com for account, billing, refund, or policy questions.

settings.question: Can I try MydreamShoots for free?
settings.answer: Some lightweight tools can be free, but private model creation and premium packs require a paid plan because they consume dedicated generation credits.

settings.question: What photos should I upload?
settings.answer: Recent, clear, high-quality phone photos work best. Use different angles, expressions, lighting, and outfits so the private model has enough visual range.

settings.question: Are my uploads private?
settings.answer: Yes. Source photos, generation jobs, albums, orders, and credits stay connected to your signed-in MydreamShoots account and are not public by default.

settings.question: What is the refund policy?
settings.answer: Unused credits can be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits that have already been spent on successful generations are not refundable.

settings.question: How do credits work?
settings.answer: Monthly plans grant credits to the customer account. Creating a package reserves the needed credits first, successful results consume them, and failed requests can return them.

settings.question: Why do premium packs need a private model?
settings.answer: A private model keeps the customer's face and style consistent across different photo packages. Simple utility tools can run without it, but premium albums need that model for better continuity.

settings.question: What happens if I cancel a plan?
settings.answer: The account can keep access to previous albums and any credit rules configured for the site. New package requests can be blocked if the subscription is not active.

settings.answer: Some lightweight tools can be free, but private model creation and premium packs require a paid plan because they consume dedicated generation credits.

settings.question: What photos should I upload?
settings.answer: Recent, clear, high-quality phone photos work best. Use different angles, expressions, lighting, and outfits so the private model has enough visual range.

settings.question: Are my uploads private?
settings.answer: Yes. Source photos, generation jobs, albums, orders, and credits stay connected to your signed-in MydreamShoots account and are not public by default.

settings.question: What is the refund policy?
settings.answer: Unused credits can be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits that have already been spent on successful generations are not refundable.

settings.question: How do credits work?
settings.answer: Monthly plans grant credits to the customer account. Creating a package reserves the needed credits first, successful results consume them, and failed requests can return them.

settings.question: Why do premium packs need a private model?
settings.answer: A private model keeps the customer's face and style consistent across different photo packages. Simple utility tools can run without it, but premium albums need that model for better continuity.

settings.question: What happens if I cancel a plan?
settings.answer: The account can keep access to previous albums and any credit rules configured for the site. New package requests can be blocked if the subscription is not active.

settings.body: This policy is written for MydreamShoots customers using www.mydreamshoots.com, our AI photo package tools, credits, and private album delivery.

settings.title: Privacy policy
settings.body:
1. Scope of this policy

This Privacy Policy explains how MydreamShoots handles information when customers visit www.mydreamshoots.com, create an account, upload source photos, buy credits or subscriptions, use AI photo packages, open private albums, contact support, or use connected checkout and generation tools.

2. Information we collect

settings.title: Refund policy
settings.body:
1. Refund eligibility

MydreamShoots sells subscriptions and credit packs for AI headshots, portraits, scene packs, image cleanup, and private album delivery. You may request a refund for unused purchased credits when those credits have not been reserved, consumed, or attached to a completed generation job.

2. Refund window

Refund requests should be sent within 30 days of purchase with the account email, order reference, and reason for the request. We review the credit history, checkout status, and generation history before approving a refund.

3. Used credits

Credits spent on successfully delivered AI photo packages are generally not refundable because provider processing, storage, and delivery resources have already been used. This includes completed headshot packs, creator portraits, fan photo sets, retouch jobs, and private albums.

4. Failed or delayed jobs

If a MydreamShoots technical failure prevents delivery, support may release reserved credits, rerun the job, provide replacement credits, or approve a refund after review. Poor source photo quality, policy violations, or customer prompt choices may limit refund eligibility.

5. Subscriptions and cancellations

Canceling a subscription stops future renewals but does not automatically refund credits already granted or used. Access to prior private albums may remain available according to account status, storage rules, and policy requirements.

6. How to contact us

Email support@mydreamshoots.com with your account email and purchase details for billing, refund, or failed-generation questions.

You may upload only photos, reference images, logos, prompts, or other materials that you own or have permission to use. You must not upload content that violates privacy, publicity, intellectual property, contractual rights, platform rules, or applicable law. You remain responsible for the materials you submit and the way you use generated outputs.

AI photo results vary based on source image quality, pose, lighting, package settings, provider availability, moderation checks, and model behavior. MydreamShoots does not guarantee that every output will match a specific expectation, identity detail, style reference, or commercial requirement. We may reject, rerun, delay, moderate, or remove jobs that violate rules or cannot be completed reliably.

Customer uploads remain subject to the rights of the customer or original owner. Your rights in generated outputs may depend on law, provider rules, your uploaded materials, and the way you use the results.

MydreamShoots is provided as an AI photo software service. Outputs may contain errors, artifacts, inaccurate details, or unexpected results. You should not rely on generated images as official identity documents, professional credentials, legal evidence, or factual records.

settings.journeyDescriptions: Add clean source photos.|Pick a scene or style.|AI builds your set.|Download from the private gallery.

settings.question: Can I try MydreamShoots for free?
settings.answer: Some lightweight tools can be free, but private model creation and premium packs require a paid plan because they consume dedicated generation credits.

settings.question: What photos should I upload?
settings.answer: Recent, clear, high-quality phone photos work best. Use different angles, expressions, lighting, and outfits so the private model has enough visual range.

settings.question: Are my uploads private?
settings.answer: Yes. Source photos, generation jobs, albums, orders, and credits stay connected to your signed-in MydreamShoots account and are not public by default.

settings.question: What is the refund policy?
settings.answer: Unused credits can be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits that have already been spent on successful generations are not refundable.

settings.question: How do credits work?
settings.answer: Monthly plans grant credits to the customer account. Creating a package reserves the needed credits first, successful results consume them, and failed requests can return them.

settings.question: Why do premium packs need a private model?
settings.answer: A private model keeps the customer's face and style consistent across different photo packages. Simple utility tools can run without it, but premium albums need that model for better continuity.

settings.question: What happens if I cancel a plan?
settings.answer: The account can keep access to previous albums and any credit rules configured for the site. New package requests can be blocked if the subscription is not active.

settings.title: Train a private identity model
settings.description: Advanced packages need a customer model so results can stay consistent across headshots, gala, travel, and style sets.

settings.title: Spend credits only when generating
settings.description: Credits are visible before a request starts and remain tied to subscription or one-time pack purchases.

settings.title: Download from the gallery

settings.question: Can I try MydreamShoots for free?
settings.answer: Some lightweight tools can be free, but private model creation and premium packs require a paid plan because they consume dedicated generation credits.

settings.question: What photos should I upload?
settings.answer: Recent, clear, high-quality phone photos work best. Use different angles, expressions, lighting, and outfits so the private model has enough visual range.

settings.question: Are my uploads private?
settings.answer: Yes. Source photos, generation jobs, albums, orders, and credits stay connected to your signed-in MydreamShoots account and are not public by default.

settings.question: What is the refund policy?
settings.answer: Unused credits can be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits that have already been spent on successful generations are not refundable.

settings.question: How do credits work?
settings.answer: Monthly plans grant credits to the customer account. Creating a package reserves the needed credits first, successful results consume them, and failed requests can return them.

settings.question: Why do premium packs need a private model?
settings.answer: A private model keeps the customer's face and style consistent across different photo packages. Simple utility tools can run without it, but premium albums need that model for better continuity.

settings.question: What happens if I cancel a plan?
settings.answer: The account can keep access to previous albums and any credit rules configured for the site. New package requests can be blocked if the subscription is not active.

settings.title: Terms of service
settings.body:
1. Agreement to these terms

These Terms of Service apply when you visit www.mydreamshoots.com, create a MydreamShoots account, upload photos, buy credits or subscriptions, use AI photo tools, start generation jobs, download outputs, or access private albums. By using the service, you agree to these terms and to the related Privacy Policy, Cookie Policy, Refund Policy, and Content Policy.

2. Accounts and eligibility

You are responsible for the accuracy of your account information and for keeping your login method secure. Account access, credits, jobs, generated images, and private albums are intended for the customer account that created or purchased them. You may not share access in a way that bypasses plan limits or harms other users.

3. Credits, subscriptions, and billing

MydreamShoots may offer subscriptions, one-time credit packs, promotional credits, or package-specific credit costs. Credits are added after payment confirmation, reserved when a generation job starts, settled when a job succeeds, and released or reviewed when a job fails or expires. Prices, credit amounts, package availability, and plan features may change over time, but checkout pages should show the current offer before purchase.

4. Upload rights and customer content

You may upload only photos, reference images, logos, prompts, or other materials that you own or have permission to use. You must not upload content that violates privacy, publicity, intellectual property, contractual rights, platform rules, or applicable law. You remain responsible for the materials you submit and the way you use generated outputs.

5. AI generation and output variability

AI photo results vary based on source image quality, pose, lighting, package settings, provider availability, moderation checks, and model behavior. MydreamShoots does not guarantee that every output will match a specific expectation, identity detail, style reference, or commercial requirement. We may reject, rerun, delay, moderate, or remove jobs that violate rules or cannot be completed reliably.

6. Private albums and downloads

Generated images and albums are designed for private customer access unless you choose to share, publish, or download them. You are responsible for reviewing outputs before using them in advertising, profiles, documents, merchandise, social media, or other public settings.

7. Acceptable use

You may not use MydreamShoots to impersonate someone without permission, create unlawful or harmful content, exploit minors, harass others, violate intellectual property, upload stolen images, attack or scrape the service, bypass access controls, resell unauthorized access, interfere with other accounts, or overload generation capacity.

8. Refunds, failed jobs, and support review

Refunds and credit adjustments are handled under the Refund Policy. Successfully delivered generation jobs are generally not refundable unless MydreamShoots confirms a service-side technical failure. Failed or timed-out jobs may result in credit release, rerun, or manual support review depending on the issue.

9. Service changes and availability

We may update packages, tools, providers, pricing, credit costs, policy pages, UI flows, and feature availability. We may also suspend access to protect customers, investigate abuse, perform maintenance, comply with law, or respond to provider outages.

10. Intellectual property

The MydreamShoots website, brand, software, templates, interface, package structure, and documentation belong to MydreamShoots or its licensors. Customer uploads remain subject to the rights of the customer or original owner. Your rights in generated outputs may depend on law, provider rules, your uploaded materials, and the way you use the results.

11. Disclaimers

MydreamShoots is provided as an AI photo software service. Outputs may contain errors, artifacts, inaccurate details, or unexpected results. You should not rely on generated images as official identity documents, professional credentials, legal evidence, or factual records.

12. Limitation of liability

To the fullest extent permitted by law, MydreamShoots is not liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages. Our total liability for a claim is limited to the amount you paid for the affected billing period, subscription, or credit purchase.

13. Changes to these terms

14. Contact

Email support@mydreamshoots.com for account, billing, refund, policy, or legal questions.

8. Relationship to privacy policy

Cookie data is handled together with the privacy practices described in our Privacy Policy. The Terms of Service explain customer responsibilities when using accounts, credits, uploads, and generated outputs.

settings.question: How do credits work?
settings.answer: Monthly plans grant credits to the customer account. Creating a package reserves the needed credits first, successful results consume them, and failed requests can return them.

settings.question: Why do premium packs need a private model?

settings.answer: The account can keep access to previous albums and any credit rules configured for the site. New package requests can be blocked if the subscription is not active.

settings.question: Can I try Aidreamcapes for free?
settings.answer: Some lightweight tools can be free, but private model creation and premium packs require a paid plan because they consume dedicated generation credits.

settings.question: What photos should I upload?
settings.answer: Recent, clear, high-quality phone photos work best. Use different angles, expressions, lighting, and outfits so the private model has enough visual range.

settings.question: Are my uploads private?
settings.answer: Yes. Source photos, generation jobs, albums, orders, and credits stay connected to your signed-in Aidreamcapes account and are not public by default.

settings.question: What is the refund policy?
settings.answer: Unused credits can be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits that have already been spent on successful generations are not refundable.

settings.question: How do credits work?
settings.answer: Monthly plans grant credits to the customer account. Creating a package reserves the needed credits first, successful results consume them, and failed requests can return them.

settings.question: Why do premium packs need a private model?
settings.answer: A private model keeps the customer's face and style consistent across different dreamscape packages. Simple utility tools can run without it, but premium albums need that model for better continuity.

settings.question: What happens if I cancel a plan?
settings.answer: The account can keep access to previous albums and any credit rules configured for the site. New package requests can be blocked if the subscription is not active.

settings.body: This policy is written for Aidreamcapes customers using www.aidreamcapes.com, our AI photo package tools, credits, and private album delivery.

settings.title: Privacy policy
settings.body:
1. Information we collect

We collect account email, source photos, generation settings, credit movements, payment status, and delivered outputs needed to operate Aidreamcapes.

2. How we use data

We use this data to create private dreamscape portraits, manage credits, deliver galleries, provide support, prevent abuse, and improve reliability.

3. Photo privacy

Uploads and generated images stay tied to the current site and customer account. We do not sell personal photos.

4. Payments

Payments are processed by the connected payment provider. We store billing state and ledger records, not full card numbers.

5. Contact

Email support@aidreamcapes.com for privacy, account, or deletion requests.

settings.title: Content policy
settings.body:
1. Upload rights

You may upload only photos, references, logos, outfits, products, or other materials that you own or have permission to use. Aidreamcapes is designed for personal AI headshots, creator portraits, fan photos, beauty edits, travel scenes, and private albums, not unauthorized use of another person's likeness or copyrighted material.

2. Identity and consent

Do not upload images of people who have not given you permission, and do not use Aidreamcapes to impersonate private individuals, public figures, coworkers, classmates, customers, or creators. Premium portrait packages should represent you or people who have clearly agreed to the generation.

3. Prohibited content

We may block, remove, or refuse content involving sexual exploitation, minors in unsafe contexts, harassment, hate, fraud, violence, illegal activity, explicit non-consensual imagery, sensitive personal data, or attempts to bypass safety systems.

4. Brands, teams, and protected marks

Sports fan photos, creator scenes, product-style images, and themed packs should avoid unauthorized team logos, official marks, celebrity likenesses, and brand assets unless you have permission. Use descriptive styling rather than pretending to be endorsed by a brand, league, team, or person.

5. Output review

AI outputs can vary. Aidreamcapes may moderate, rerun, remove, or restrict delivery of generated images that violate policy, create safety risk, or appear to misuse identity, intellectual property, or private information.

6. Questions

Email support@aidreamcapes.com if you are unsure whether a source photo, reference, or requested style is allowed.

settings.title: How cookies support sign-in, checkout, and private albums.
settings.body: This policy explains the cookies and local storage used on www.aidreamcapes.com for the Aidreamcapes AI photo service.

settings.title: Cookie policy
settings.body:
1. What cookies are

Cookies are small files stored by your browser. Aidreamcapes also uses similar browser storage, such as local storage, to keep the AI photo service secure, usable, and consistent while you move between packages, checkout, your account, and private albums.

2. Essential cookies

Essential cookies support customer sign-in, scoped sessions, CSRF protection, checkout continuity, credit reservation flows, private album access, rate limiting, fraud prevention, and secure admin or customer authentication. These cookies are required for the core service and cannot be switched off inside the site without breaking key features.

3. Preference storage

We may remember practical preferences such as menu state, recently opened workspace views, selected package context, language or display choices if available, and browser-side UI settings. This helps Aidreamcapes open the right customer workspace more quickly.

4. Performance and diagnostics

We may collect limited technical signals to understand slow pages, failed requests, broken checkout steps, job submission errors, and account access issues. These signals help us improve route speed, generation reliability, and customer support.

5. Analytics and measurement

If analytics tools are enabled, they may help us understand aggregated usage such as popular package categories, tool discovery, pricing page visits, and conversion paths. Analytics should not be used to sell your uploaded photos or generated images.

6. Payment, email, hosting, and AI providers

Connected providers may set or read cookies or similar identifiers when needed for checkout, anti-fraud checks, email delivery, hosting security, media storage, or AI generation. Their use is limited to providing and protecting the requested service.

7. Your browser controls

You can block, delete, or limit cookies in your browser settings. If you block essential cookies, Aidreamcapes may not be able to keep you signed in, complete checkout, reserve credits, start generation jobs, or open private albums.

8. Relationship to privacy policy

Cookie data is handled together with the privacy practices described in our Privacy Policy. The Terms of Service explain customer responsibilities when using accounts, credits, uploads, and generated outputs.

9. Updates and contact

We may update this Cookie Policy as we add or remove providers, analytics, checkout methods, or security features. Email support@aidreamcapes.com with cookie or tracking questions.

settings.question: Can I try Aidreamcapes for free?
settings.answer: Some lightweight tools can be free, but private model creation and premium packs require a paid plan because they consume dedicated generation credits.

settings.question: What photos should I upload?
settings.answer: Recent, clear, high-quality phone photos work best. Use different angles, expressions, lighting, and outfits so the private model has enough visual range.

settings.question: Are my uploads private?
settings.answer: Yes. Source photos, generation jobs, albums, orders, and credits stay connected to your signed-in Aidreamcapes account and are not public by default.

settings.question: What is the refund policy?
settings.answer: Unused credits can be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits that have already been spent on successful generations are not refundable.

settings.question: How do credits work?
settings.answer: Monthly plans grant credits to the customer account. Creating a package reserves the needed credits first, successful results consume them, and failed requests can return them.

settings.question: Why do premium packs need a private model?
settings.answer: A private model keeps the customer's face and style consistent across different dreamscape packages. Simple utility tools can run without it, but premium albums need that model for better continuity.

settings.question: What happens if I cancel a plan?
settings.answer: The account can keep access to previous albums and any credit rules configured for the site. New package requests can be blocked if the subscription is not active.

settings.question: Is this really AI-generated?
settings.answer: Yes. We use your uploaded couple photos and chosen destination or style direction to generate realistic, editorial wedding imagery.

settings.question: How long does it take?
settings.answer: Most wedding story albums are delivered within 3-5 days depending on your plan, revision needs, and output count.

settings.question: Can I request styles?
settings.answer: Yes. You can choose destination moods, ceremony aesthetics, wardrobe direction, and cinematic or editorial styling during the workflow.

settings.question: Are photos high-resolution?
settings.answer: Yes. Final deliveries are prepared for digital sharing and keepsake printing, with quality depending on your selected package.

settings.question: Can I print the photos?
settings.answer: Yes. Delivered files are intended for keepsakes, announcements, framed prints, and private wedding albums.

settings.title: Terms that govern customer accounts and private delivery.
settings.body: These terms explain access, billing, customer usage, and the responsibilities of the site owner and customer.

settings.title: Terms of service
settings.body:
1. Acceptance

By using this site, you agree to these terms and to the privacy policy that governs uploads, generated outputs, purchases, and private delivery.

2. Accounts

Customers must provide accurate account information and keep credentials secure. Each account belongs to the photo workspace and cannot be shared across unrelated site customer records.

3. Subscriptions and credits

Subscriptions and one-time credit packs provide credits for AI photo generation. Credits are granted after confirmed payment, reserved when a job starts, consumed after successful delivery, and released when a job fails or times out.

4. Refunds

Unused credits may be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits already spent on successful generations are not refundable unless support confirms a service-side technical failure.

5. Uploaded content

You may only upload images and references you control or have permission to use. The site may reject, review, remove, or block content that violates law, platform rules, or safety policy.

6. Delivery

Completed jobs are delivered to the signed-in customer account. Delivery states, retries, credit releases, and refunds are handled by the backend and recorded in your credit history.

7. Liability

The service is provided as a software subscription. To the extent permitted by law, liability is limited to the fees paid for the current billing period or the affected credit purchase.

8. Contact us

Email support@mydreamshoots.com for account, billing, refund, or policy questions.

settings.title: Terms of service
settings.body:
1. Acceptance

By using this site, you agree to these terms and to the privacy policy that governs uploads, generated outputs, purchases, and private delivery.

2. Accounts

Customers must provide accurate account information and keep credentials secure. Each account belongs to the photo workspace and cannot be shared across unrelated site customer records.

3. Subscriptions and credits

Subscriptions and one-time credit packs provide credits for AI photo generation. Credits are granted after confirmed payment, reserved when a job starts, consumed after successful delivery, and released when a job fails or times out.

4. Refunds

Unused credits may be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits already spent on successful generations are not refundable unless support confirms a service-side technical failure.

5. Uploaded content

You may only upload images and references you control or have permission to use. The site may reject, review, remove, or block content that violates law, platform rules, or safety policy.

6. Delivery

Completed jobs are delivered to the signed-in customer account. Delivery states, retries, credit releases, and refunds are handled by the backend and recorded in your credit history.

7. Liability

The service is provided as a software subscription. To the extent permitted by law, liability is limited to the fees paid for the current billing period or the affected credit purchase.

8. Contact us

Email support@mydreamshoots.com for account, billing, refund, or policy questions.

settings.title: Terms that govern customer accounts and private delivery.
settings.body: These terms explain access, billing, customer usage, and the responsibilities of the site owner and customer.

settings.title: Terms of service
settings.body:
1. Acceptance

By using this site, you agree to these terms and to the privacy policy that governs uploads, generated outputs, purchases, and private delivery.

2. Accounts

Customers must provide accurate account information and keep credentials secure. Each account belongs to the photo workspace and cannot be shared across unrelated site customer records.

3. Subscriptions and credits

Subscriptions and one-time credit packs provide credits for AI photo generation. Credits are granted after confirmed payment, reserved when a job starts, consumed after successful delivery, and released when a job fails or times out.

4. Refunds

Unused credits may be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits already spent on successful generations are not refundable unless support confirms a service-side technical failure.

5. Uploaded content

You may only upload images and references you control or have permission to use. The site may reject, review, remove, or block content that violates law, platform rules, or safety policy.

6. Delivery

Completed jobs are delivered to the signed-in customer account. Delivery states, retries, credit releases, and refunds are handled by the backend and recorded in your credit history.

7. Liability

The service is provided as a software subscription. To the extent permitted by law, liability is limited to the fees paid for the current billing period or the affected credit purchase.

8. Contact us

Email support@mydreamshoots.com for account, billing, refund, or policy questions.

settings.question: Can I try MydreamShoots for free?
settings.answer: Some lightweight tools can be free, but private model creation and premium packs require a paid plan because they consume dedicated generation credits.

settings.question: What photos should I upload?
settings.answer: Recent, clear, high-quality phone photos work best. Use different angles, expressions, lighting, and outfits so the private model has enough visual range.

settings.question: What is the refund policy?
settings.answer: Unused credits can be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits that have already been spent on successful generations are not refundable.

settings.question: How do credits work?
settings.answer: Monthly plans grant credits to the customer account. Creating a package reserves the needed credits first, successful results consume them, and failed requests can return them.

settings.question: Why do premium packs need a private model?
settings.answer: A private model keeps the customer's face and style consistent across different photo packages. Simple utility tools can run without it, but premium albums need that model for better continuity.

settings.question: What happens if I cancel a plan?
settings.answer: The account can keep access to previous albums and any credit rules configured for the site. New package requests can be blocked if the subscription is not active.

settings.title: Privacy policy
settings.body:
1. Information we collect

We collect the email address used for your account, source photos you upload, generation settings, payment status, credit movements, and delivered outputs needed to operate the service.

2. How we use data

We use your data to create AI photo packages, manage credits and subscriptions, deliver private galleries, provide support, prevent abuse, and improve product reliability.

3. Photo privacy

Uploads and generated images stay tied to the signed-in customer account. We do not sell personal photos, and account data is kept private from other customers.

4. Payments

Payments are processed by Stripe or the connected payment account for this photo workspace. We store billing status, order references, and credit movements, not full card numbers.

5. Security

The service is served over HTTPS. Access to private albums, customer assets, jobs, and billing records is scoped by site and customer session.

6. Retention and deletion

You may request deletion of uploaded assets or generated outputs. Some billing, credit history, and abuse-prevention records may be retained where legally or operationally required.

7. Contact

Email support@mydreamshoots.com for privacy, account, or deletion requests.

settings.title: Refund policy
settings.body:
Refund eligibility

You may request a refund for purchased credits if none of the credits from that purchase have been used. Once credits have been spent on a successful generation, that purchase becomes non-refundable.

Refund window

Refund requests should be submitted within 30 days of the purchase date with your account email and purchase details.

Subscriptions

If a subscription is canceled, the customer keeps access to purchased credits until they are used or expire according to the plan rules. Cancellation does not automatically refund credits already used.

Technical failures

If a technical failure on our side prevents credit use or delivery, support may release credits, rerun the job, or approve a refund after review.

Credit history

Refunds and billing reversals are recorded against this photo workspace. Checkout completion never grants credits before payment confirmation, and every adjustment is written through the credit history.

settings.title: Terms of Service
settings.body:
1. Acceptance

By using this site, you agree to these terms and to the privacy policy that governs uploads, generated outputs, purchases, and private delivery.

2. Accounts

Customers must provide accurate account information and keep credentials secure. Each account belongs to the photo workspace and cannot be shared across unrelated site customer records.

3. Subscriptions and credits

Subscriptions and one-time credit packs provide credits for AI photo generation. Credits are granted after confirmed payment, reserved when a job starts, consumed after successful delivery, and released when a job fails or times out.

4. Refunds

Unused credits may be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits already spent on successful generations are not refundable unless support confirms a service-side technical failure.

5. Uploaded content

You may only upload images and references you control or have permission to use. The site may reject, review, remove, or block content that violates law, platform rules, or safety policy.

6. Delivery

Completed jobs are delivered to the signed-in customer account. Delivery states, retries, credit releases, and refunds are handled by the backend and recorded in your credit history.

7. Liability

The service is provided as a software subscription. To the extent permitted by law, liability is limited to the fees paid for the current billing period or the affected credit purchase.

8. Contact us

Email support@mydreamshoots.com for account, billing, refund, or policy questions.

settings.title: Privacy policy
settings.body:
1. Information we collect

We collect the email address used for your account, source photos you upload, generation settings, payment status, credit movements, and delivered outputs needed to operate the service.

2. How we use data

We use your data to create AI photo packages, manage credits and subscriptions, deliver private galleries, provide support, prevent abuse, and improve product reliability.

3. Photo privacy

Uploads and generated images stay tied to the signed-in customer account. We do not sell personal photos, and account data is kept private from other customers.

4. Payments

Payments are processed by Stripe or the connected payment account for this photo workspace. We store billing status, order references, and credit movements, not full card numbers.

5. Security

The service is served over HTTPS. Access to private albums, customer assets, jobs, and billing records is scoped by site and customer session.

6. Retention and deletion

You may request deletion of uploaded assets or generated outputs. Some billing, credit history, and abuse-prevention records may be retained where legally or operationally required.

7. Contact

Email support@mydreamshoots.com for privacy, account, or deletion requests.

settings.title: Refund policy
settings.body:
Refund eligibility

You may request a refund for purchased credits if none of the credits from that purchase have been used. Once credits have been spent on a successful generation, that purchase becomes non-refundable.

Refund window

Refund requests should be submitted within 30 days of the purchase date with your account email and purchase details.

Subscriptions

If a subscription is canceled, the customer keeps access to purchased credits until they are used or expire according to the plan rules. Cancellation does not automatically refund credits already used.

Technical failures

If a technical failure on our side prevents credit use or delivery, support may release credits, rerun the job, or approve a refund after review.

Credit history

Refunds and billing reversals are recorded against this photo workspace. Checkout completion never grants credits before payment confirmation, and every adjustment is written through the credit history.

settings.title: Terms of Service
settings.body:
1. Acceptance

By using this site, you agree to these terms and to the privacy policy that governs uploads, generated outputs, purchases, and private delivery.

2. Accounts

Customers must provide accurate account information and keep credentials secure. Each account belongs to the photo workspace and cannot be shared across unrelated site customer records.

3. Subscriptions and credits

Subscriptions and one-time credit packs provide credits for AI photo generation. Credits are granted after confirmed payment, reserved when a job starts, consumed after successful delivery, and released when a job fails or times out.

4. Refunds

Unused credits may be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits already spent on successful generations are not refundable unless support confirms a service-side technical failure.

5. Uploaded content

You may only upload images and references you control or have permission to use. The site may reject, review, remove, or block content that violates law, platform rules, or safety policy.

6. Delivery

Completed jobs are delivered to the signed-in customer account. Delivery states, retries, credit releases, and refunds are handled by the backend and recorded in your credit history.

7. Liability

The service is provided as a software subscription. To the extent permitted by law, liability is limited to the fees paid for the current billing period or the affected credit purchase.

8. Contact us

Email support@mydreamshoots.com for account, billing, refund, or policy questions.

settings.question: Can I try Aidreamcapes for free?
settings.answer: Some lightweight tools can be free, but private model creation and premium packs require a paid plan because they consume dedicated generation credits.

settings.question: What photos should I upload?
settings.answer: Recent, clear, high-quality phone photos work best. Use different angles, expressions, lighting, and outfits so the private model has enough visual range.

settings.question: Are my uploads private?
settings.answer: Yes. Source photos, generation jobs, albums, orders, and credits stay connected to your signed-in Aidreamcapes account and are not public by default.

settings.question: What is the refund policy?
settings.answer: Unused credits can be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits that have already been spent on successful generations are not refundable.

settings.question: How do credits work?
settings.answer: Monthly plans grant credits to the customer account. Creating a package reserves the needed credits first, successful results consume them, and failed requests can return them.

settings.question: Why do premium packs need a private model?
settings.answer: A private model keeps the customer's face and style consistent across different dreamscape packages. Simple utility tools can run without it, but premium albums need that model for better continuity.

settings.question: What happens if I cancel a plan?
settings.answer: The account can keep access to previous albums and any credit rules configured for the site. New package requests can be blocked if the subscription is not active.

settings.title: How Aidreamcapes handles your photo and account data.
settings.body: This policy is written for Aidreamcapes customers using www.aidreamcapes.com, our AI photo package tools, credits, and private album delivery.

settings.title: Privacy policy
settings.body:
1. Information we collect

We collect account email, source photos, generation settings, credit movements, payment status, and delivered outputs needed to operate Aidreamcapes.

2. How we use data

We use this data to create private dreamscape portraits, manage credits, deliver galleries, provide support, prevent abuse, and improve reliability.

3. Photo privacy

Uploads and generated images stay tied to the current site and customer account. We do not sell personal photos.

4. Payments

Payments are processed by the connected payment provider. We store billing state and ledger records, not full card numbers.

5. Contact

Email support@aidreamcapes.com for privacy, account, or deletion requests.

settings.title: Privacy
settings.body: Photo, account, and billing-data practices for Aidreamcapes customers.

settings.title: Refund policy
settings.body:
Refund eligibility

You may request a refund for purchased credits if none of the credits from that purchase have been used.

Technical failures

If a service-side failure prevents generation or delivery, support may release credits, rerun the request, or review a refund.

Subscriptions

Canceling a subscription stops future renewal. Credits already spent on successful generations are not refundable.

settings.title: Terms for using Aidreamcapes dreamscape packages, credits, and albums.
settings.body: These terms apply when you use www.aidreamcapes.com, create an account, buy credits, start AI photo jobs, or access private generated albums.

settings.title: Terms of Service
settings.body:
1. Acceptance

By using Aidreamcapes, you agree to these terms and the privacy policy.

2. Accounts

Customers must provide accurate account information and keep credentials secure.

3. Credits and delivery

Credits are granted after confirmed payment, reserved when a request starts, consumed after successful delivery, and released when a request fails or times out.

4. Uploaded content

You may only upload images and references you control or have permission to use.

5. Contact

Email support@aidreamcapes.com for account, billing, or policy questions.

settings.title: Terms
settings.body: Service terms for Aidreamcapes customers.

settings.title: Content policy
settings.body:
1. Upload rights

You may upload only photos, references, logos, outfits, products, or other materials that you own or have permission to use. Aidreamcapes is designed for personal AI headshots, creator portraits, fan photos, beauty edits, travel scenes, and private albums, not unauthorized use of another person's likeness or copyrighted material.

2. Identity and consent

Do not upload images of people who have not given you permission, and do not use Aidreamcapes to impersonate private individuals, public figures, coworkers, classmates, customers, or creators. Premium portrait packages should represent you or people who have clearly agreed to the generation.

3. Prohibited content

We may block, remove, or refuse content involving sexual exploitation, minors in unsafe contexts, harassment, hate, fraud, violence, illegal activity, explicit non-consensual imagery, sensitive personal data, or attempts to bypass safety systems.

4. Brands, teams, and protected marks

Sports fan photos, creator scenes, product-style images, and themed packs should avoid unauthorized team logos, official marks, celebrity likenesses, and brand assets unless you have permission. Use descriptive styling rather than pretending to be endorsed by a brand, league, team, or person.

5. Output review

AI outputs can vary. Aidreamcapes may moderate, rerun, remove, or restrict delivery of generated images that violate policy, create safety risk, or appear to misuse identity, intellectual property, or private information.

6. Questions

Email support@aidreamcapes.com if you are unsure whether a source photo, reference, or requested style is allowed.

settings.title: How cookies support sign-in, checkout, and private albums.
settings.body: This policy explains the cookies and local storage used on www.aidreamcapes.com for the Aidreamcapes AI photo service.

settings.title: Cookie policy
settings.body:
1. What cookies are

Cookies are small files stored by your browser. Aidreamcapes also uses similar browser storage, such as local storage, to keep the AI photo service secure, usable, and consistent while you move between packages, checkout, your account, and private albums.

2. Essential cookies

Essential cookies support customer sign-in, scoped sessions, CSRF protection, checkout continuity, credit reservation flows, private album access, rate limiting, fraud prevention, and secure admin or customer authentication. These cookies are required for the core service and cannot be switched off inside the site without breaking key features.

3. Preference storage

We may remember practical preferences such as menu state, recently opened workspace views, selected package context, language or display choices if available, and browser-side UI settings. This helps Aidreamcapes open the right customer workspace more quickly.

4. Performance and diagnostics

We may collect limited technical signals to understand slow pages, failed requests, broken checkout steps, job submission errors, and account access issues. These signals help us improve route speed, generation reliability, and customer support.

5. Analytics and measurement

If analytics tools are enabled, they may help us understand aggregated usage such as popular package categories, tool discovery, pricing page visits, and conversion paths. Analytics should not be used to sell your uploaded photos or generated images.

6. Payment, email, hosting, and AI providers

Connected providers may set or read cookies or similar identifiers when needed for checkout, anti-fraud checks, email delivery, hosting security, media storage, or AI generation. Their use is limited to providing and protecting the requested service.

7. Your browser controls

You can block, delete, or limit cookies in your browser settings. If you block essential cookies, Aidreamcapes may not be able to keep you signed in, complete checkout, reserve credits, start generation jobs, or open private albums.

8. Relationship to privacy policy

Cookie data is handled together with the privacy practices described in our Privacy Policy. The Terms of Service explain customer responsibilities when using accounts, credits, uploads, and generated outputs.

9. Updates and contact

We may update this Cookie Policy as we add or remove providers, analytics, checkout methods, or security features. Email support@aidreamcapes.com with cookie or tracking questions.

settings.title: How Aidreamcapes handles your photo and account data.
settings.body: This policy is written for Aidreamcapes customers using www.aidreamcapes.com, our AI photo package tools, credits, and private album delivery.

settings.title: Privacy policy
settings.body:
1. Information we collect

We collect account email, source photos, generation settings, credit movements, payment status, and delivered outputs needed to operate Aidreamcapes.

2. How we use data

We use this data to create private dreamscape portraits, manage credits, deliver galleries, provide support, prevent abuse, and improve reliability.

3. Photo privacy

Uploads and generated images stay tied to the current site and customer account. We do not sell personal photos.

4. Payments

Payments are processed by the connected payment provider. We store billing state and ledger records, not full card numbers.

5. Contact

Email support@aidreamcapes.com for privacy, account, or deletion requests.

settings.title: Privacy
settings.body: Photo, account, and billing-data practices for Aidreamcapes customers.

settings.title: Refund policy
settings.body:
Refund eligibility

You may request a refund for purchased credits if none of the credits from that purchase have been used.

Technical failures

If a service-side failure prevents generation or delivery, support may release credits, rerun the request, or review a refund.

Subscriptions

Canceling a subscription stops future renewal. Credits already spent on successful generations are not refundable.

settings.title: Terms for using Aidreamcapes dreamscape packages, credits, and albums.
settings.body: These terms apply when you use www.aidreamcapes.com, create an account, buy credits, start AI photo jobs, or access private generated albums.

settings.title: Terms of Service
settings.body:
1. Acceptance

By using Aidreamcapes, you agree to these terms and the privacy policy.

2. Accounts

Customers must provide accurate account information and keep credentials secure.

3. Credits and delivery

Credits are granted after confirmed payment, reserved when a request starts, consumed after successful delivery, and released when a request fails or times out.

4. Uploaded content

You may only upload images and references you control or have permission to use.

5. Contact

Email support@aidreamcapes.com for account, billing, or policy questions.

settings.title: Terms
settings.body: Service terms for Aidreamcapes customers.

settings.title: Content policy
settings.body:
1. Upload rights

You may upload only photos, references, logos, outfits, products, or other materials that you own or have permission to use. Aidreamcapes is designed for personal AI headshots, creator portraits, fan photos, beauty edits, travel scenes, and private albums, not unauthorized use of another person's likeness or copyrighted material.

2. Identity and consent

Do not upload images of people who have not given you permission, and do not use Aidreamcapes to impersonate private individuals, public figures, coworkers, classmates, customers, or creators. Premium portrait packages should represent you or people who have clearly agreed to the generation.

3. Prohibited content

We may block, remove, or refuse content involving sexual exploitation, minors in unsafe contexts, harassment, hate, fraud, violence, illegal activity, explicit non-consensual imagery, sensitive personal data, or attempts to bypass safety systems.

4. Brands, teams, and protected marks

Sports fan photos, creator scenes, product-style images, and themed packs should avoid unauthorized team logos, official marks, celebrity likenesses, and brand assets unless you have permission. Use descriptive styling rather than pretending to be endorsed by a brand, league, team, or person.

5. Output review

AI outputs can vary. Aidreamcapes may moderate, rerun, remove, or restrict delivery of generated images that violate policy, create safety risk, or appear to misuse identity, intellectual property, or private information.

6. Questions

Email support@aidreamcapes.com if you are unsure whether a source photo, reference, or requested style is allowed.

settings.title: How cookies support sign-in, checkout, and private albums.
settings.body: This policy explains the cookies and local storage used on www.aidreamcapes.com for the Aidreamcapes AI photo service.

settings.title: Cookie policy
settings.body:
1. What cookies are

Cookies are small files stored by your browser. Aidreamcapes also uses similar browser storage, such as local storage, to keep the AI photo service secure, usable, and consistent while you move between packages, checkout, your account, and private albums.

2. Essential cookies

Essential cookies support customer sign-in, scoped sessions, CSRF protection, checkout continuity, credit reservation flows, private album access, rate limiting, fraud prevention, and secure admin or customer authentication. These cookies are required for the core service and cannot be switched off inside the site without breaking key features.

3. Preference storage

We may remember practical preferences such as menu state, recently opened workspace views, selected package context, language or display choices if available, and browser-side UI settings. This helps Aidreamcapes open the right customer workspace more quickly.

4. Performance and diagnostics

We may collect limited technical signals to understand slow pages, failed requests, broken checkout steps, job submission errors, and account access issues. These signals help us improve route speed, generation reliability, and customer support.

5. Analytics and measurement

If analytics tools are enabled, they may help us understand aggregated usage such as popular package categories, tool discovery, pricing page visits, and conversion paths. Analytics should not be used to sell your uploaded photos or generated images.

6. Payment, email, hosting, and AI providers

Connected providers may set or read cookies or similar identifiers when needed for checkout, anti-fraud checks, email delivery, hosting security, media storage, or AI generation. Their use is limited to providing and protecting the requested service.

7. Your browser controls

You can block, delete, or limit cookies in your browser settings. If you block essential cookies, Aidreamcapes may not be able to keep you signed in, complete checkout, reserve credits, start generation jobs, or open private albums.

8. Relationship to privacy policy

Cookie data is handled together with the privacy practices described in our Privacy Policy. The Terms of Service explain customer responsibilities when using accounts, credits, uploads, and generated outputs.

9. Updates and contact

We may update this Cookie Policy as we add or remove providers, analytics, checkout methods, or security features. Email support@aidreamcapes.com with cookie or tracking questions.

settings.question: Can I try Aidreamcapes for free?
settings.answer: Some lightweight tools can be free, but private model creation and premium packs require a paid plan because they consume dedicated generation credits.

settings.question: What photos should I upload?
settings.answer: Recent, clear, high-quality phone photos work best. Use different angles, expressions, lighting, and outfits so the private model has enough visual range.

settings.question: Are my uploads private?
settings.answer: Yes. Source photos, generation jobs, albums, orders, and credits stay connected to your signed-in Aidreamcapes account and are not public by default.

settings.question: What is the refund policy?
settings.answer: Unused credits can be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits that have already been spent on successful generations are not refundable.

settings.question: How do credits work?
settings.answer: Monthly plans grant credits to the customer account. Creating a package reserves the needed credits first, successful results consume them, and failed requests can return them.

settings.question: Why do premium packs need a private model?
settings.answer: A private model keeps the customer's face and style consistent across different dreamscape packages. Simple utility tools can run without it, but premium albums need that model for better continuity.

settings.question: What happens if I cancel a plan?
settings.answer: The account can keep access to previous albums and any credit rules configured for the site. New package requests can be blocked if the subscription is not active.

settings.title: How to prepare source photos for better AI headshots and portraits
settings.body: Strong AI photo results start before generation. Use recent, high-resolution source photos with natural light, varied angles, different expressions, and clean backgrounds. Avoid heavy filters, sunglasses, extreme crops, and group photos when you want consistent headshots or creator portraits. For themed packs like gala, cyberpunk, travel, beauty, or World Cup fan photos, add references for wardrobe, mood, and use case so the final private album feels intentional rather than generic.

settings.title: Privacy policy
settings.body:
1. Scope of this policy

This Privacy Policy explains how MydreamShoots handles information when customers visit www.mydreamshoots.com, create an account, upload source photos, buy credits or subscriptions, use AI photo packages, open private albums, contact support, or use connected checkout and generation tools.

2. Information we collect

We collect account information such as your email address, authentication method, session records, customer profile details, support messages, and communication preferences. We also process uploaded source photos, reference images, package selections, prompts or style choices you submit, generated previews, delivered images, albums, order records, subscription status, credit ledger events, checkout references, device signals, browser type, approximate request metadata, and security logs.

3. How we use information

MydreamShoots uses this information to operate customer accounts, generate requested AI photo results, reserve and settle credits, deliver private albums, process checkout, detect failed jobs, provide customer support, secure the service, prevent misuse, improve reliability, test new package workflows, and show the correct pages after you sign in.

4. Uploaded photos and generated images

Your uploads and generated results are treated as private customer assets. They are connected to your signed-in account and are not sold as stock images, published in public galleries, or transferred to unrelated storefronts by default. You decide whether to download, share, or reuse your delivered images. We may temporarily process uploads and outputs with infrastructure or AI providers only to complete the service you requested.

5. Payments, credits, and checkout records

Payments may be processed by Stripe or another connected payment provider. MydreamShoots stores order IDs, checkout status, plan names, credit purchases, credit reservations, refunds, reversals, and subscription events so your account balance remains accurate. We do not store full card numbers on our own servers.

6. Cookies and similar technology

We use cookies, local storage, and similar tools for sign-in, session security, CSRF protection, checkout continuity, preference memory, rate limiting, diagnostics, and limited analytics. See the Cookie Policy for more detail.

7. Service providers

We may use hosting, database, storage, email, analytics, payment, moderation, and AI infrastructure providers. These providers may process limited customer data only for the purpose of running, securing, generating, storing, or delivering the MydreamShoots service.

8. Retention and deletion

Uploads, generated results, albums, order records, and credit history may remain available while your account is active so you can revisit past work. You may request deletion of uploaded or generated photos. Some billing, fraud-prevention, tax, security, dispute, and account integrity records may be retained where required or reasonably necessary.

9. Your choices

You may contact us to request access, correction, export, deletion, or help with account privacy. We may need to verify your identity or account ownership before acting on sensitive requests. Browser controls may also let you manage cookies and local storage.

10. Security

We use account-scoped sessions, private customer routes, access checks, security cookies, and operational monitoring to reduce unauthorized access. No online service can guarantee perfect security, so customers should protect their login method and contact us quickly if they suspect unauthorized account use.

11. Children

MydreamShoots is not intended for children under the age required to consent to online services in their location. Customers should not upload photos of minors unless they have the legal right and consent to do so.

12. Changes and contact

We may update this policy as features, providers, or legal requirements change. Email support@mydreamshoots.com for privacy, account, deletion, or data-use questions.

settings.title: FAQ
settings.subtitle: Answer pricing, privacy, uploads, and plan questions before customers spend credits.
settings.journeyDescriptions: Add clean source photos.|Pick a scene or style.|AI builds your set.|Download from the private gallery.

settings.question: Can I try MydreamShoots for free?
settings.answer: Some lightweight tools can be free, but private model creation and premium packs require a paid plan because they consume dedicated generation credits.

settings.question: What photos should I upload?
settings.answer: Recent, clear, high-quality phone photos work best. Use different angles, expressions, lighting, and outfits so the private model has enough visual range.

settings.question: Are my uploads private?
settings.answer: Yes. Uploads, jobs, albums, orders, and credits are scoped to the private account and the current customer account.

settings.question: What is the refund policy?
settings.answer: Unused credits can be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits that have already been spent on successful generations are not refundable.

settings.question: How do credits work?
settings.answer: Monthly plans grant credits to the customer account. Creating a package reserves the needed credits first, successful results consume them, and failed requests can return them.

settings.question: Why do premium packs need a private model?
settings.answer: A private model keeps the customer's face and style consistent across different photo packages. Simple utility tools can run without it, but premium albums need that model for better continuity.

settings.question: What happens if I cancel a plan?
settings.answer: The account can keep access to previous albums and any credit rules configured for the site. New package requests can be blocked if the subscription is not active.

settings.title: Privacy policy
settings.body:
1. Scope of this policy

This Privacy Policy explains how MydreamShoots handles information when customers visit www.mydreamshoots.com, create an account, upload source photos, buy credits or subscriptions, use AI photo packages, open private albums, contact support, or use connected checkout and generation tools.

2. Information we collect

We collect account information such as your email address, authentication method, session records, customer profile details, support messages, and communication preferences. We also process uploaded source photos, reference images, package selections, prompts or style choices you submit, generated previews, delivered images, albums, order records, subscription status, credit ledger events, checkout references, device signals, browser type, approximate request metadata, and security logs.

3. How we use information

MydreamShoots uses this information to operate customer accounts, generate requested AI photo results, reserve and settle credits, deliver private albums, process checkout, detect failed jobs, provide customer support, secure the service, prevent misuse, improve reliability, test new package workflows, and show the correct pages after you sign in.

4. Uploaded photos and generated images

Your uploads and generated results are treated as private customer assets. They are connected to your signed-in account and are not sold as stock images, published in public galleries, or transferred to unrelated storefronts by default. You decide whether to download, share, or reuse your delivered images. We may temporarily process uploads and outputs with infrastructure or AI providers only to complete the service you requested.

5. Payments, credits, and checkout records

Payments may be processed by Stripe or another connected payment provider. MydreamShoots stores order IDs, checkout status, plan names, credit purchases, credit reservations, refunds, reversals, and subscription events so your account balance remains accurate. We do not store full card numbers on our own servers.

6. Cookies and similar technology

We use cookies, local storage, and similar tools for sign-in, session security, CSRF protection, checkout continuity, preference memory, rate limiting, diagnostics, and limited analytics. See the Cookie Policy for more detail.

7. Service providers

We may use hosting, database, storage, email, analytics, payment, moderation, and AI infrastructure providers. These providers may process limited customer data only for the purpose of running, securing, generating, storing, or delivering the MydreamShoots service.

8. Retention and deletion

Uploads, generated results, albums, order records, and credit history may remain available while your account is active so you can revisit past work. You may request deletion of uploaded or generated photos. Some billing, fraud-prevention, tax, security, dispute, and account integrity records may be retained where required or reasonably necessary.

9. Your choices

You may contact us to request access, correction, export, deletion, or help with account privacy. We may need to verify your identity or account ownership before acting on sensitive requests. Browser controls may also let you manage cookies and local storage.

10. Security

We use account-scoped sessions, private customer routes, access checks, security cookies, and operational monitoring to reduce unauthorized access. No online service can guarantee perfect security, so customers should protect their login method and contact us quickly if they suspect unauthorized account use.

11. Children

MydreamShoots is not intended for children under the age required to consent to online services in their location. Customers should not upload photos of minors unless they have the legal right and consent to do so.

12. Changes and contact

We may update this policy as features, providers, or legal requirements change. Email support@mydreamshoots.com for privacy, account, deletion, or data-use questions.

settings.title: Refund policy
settings.body:
Refund eligibility

You may request a refund for purchased credits if none of the credits from that purchase have been used. Once credits have been spent on a successful generation, that purchase becomes non-refundable.

Refund window

Refund requests should be submitted within 30 days of the purchase date with your account email and purchase details.

Subscriptions

If a subscription is canceled, the customer keeps access to purchased credits until they are used or expire according to the plan rules. Cancellation does not automatically refund credits already used.

Technical failures

If a technical failure on our side prevents credit use or delivery, support may release credits, rerun the job, or approve a refund after review.

Credit history

Refunds and billing reversals are recorded against this photo workspace. Checkout completion never grants credits before payment confirmation, and every adjustment is written through the credit history.

settings.title: Terms of Service
settings.body:
1. Agreement to these terms

These Terms of Service apply when you visit www.mydreamshoots.com, create a MydreamShoots account, upload photos, buy credits or subscriptions, use AI photo tools, start generation jobs, download outputs, or access private albums. By using the service, you agree to these terms and to the related Privacy Policy, Cookie Policy, Refund Policy, and Content Policy.

2. Accounts and eligibility

You are responsible for the accuracy of your account information and for keeping your login method secure. Account access, credits, jobs, generated images, and private albums are intended for the customer account that created or purchased them. You may not share access in a way that bypasses plan limits or harms other users.

3. Credits, subscriptions, and billing

MydreamShoots may offer subscriptions, one-time credit packs, promotional credits, or package-specific credit costs. Credits are added after payment confirmation, reserved when a generation job starts, settled when a job succeeds, and released or reviewed when a job fails or expires. Prices, credit amounts, package availability, and plan features may change over time, but checkout pages should show the current offer before purchase.

4. Upload rights and customer content

You may upload only photos, reference images, logos, prompts, or other materials that you own or have permission to use. You must not upload content that violates privacy, publicity, intellectual property, contractual rights, platform rules, or applicable law. You remain responsible for the materials you submit and the way you use generated outputs.

5. AI generation and output variability

AI photo results vary based on source image quality, pose, lighting, package settings, provider availability, moderation checks, and model behavior. MydreamShoots does not guarantee that every output will match a specific expectation, identity detail, style reference, or commercial requirement. We may reject, rerun, delay, moderate, or remove jobs that violate rules or cannot be completed reliably.

6. Private albums and downloads

Generated images and albums are designed for private customer access unless you choose to share, publish, or download them. You are responsible for reviewing outputs before using them in advertising, profiles, documents, merchandise, social media, or other public settings.

7. Acceptable use

You may not use MydreamShoots to impersonate someone without permission, create unlawful or harmful content, exploit minors, harass others, violate intellectual property, upload stolen images, attack or scrape the service, bypass access controls, resell unauthorized access, interfere with other accounts, or overload generation capacity.

8. Refunds, failed jobs, and support review

Refunds and credit adjustments are handled under the Refund Policy. Successfully delivered generation jobs are generally not refundable unless MydreamShoots confirms a service-side technical failure. Failed or timed-out jobs may result in credit release, rerun, or manual support review depending on the issue.

9. Service changes and availability

We may update packages, tools, providers, pricing, credit costs, policy pages, UI flows, and feature availability. We may also suspend access to protect customers, investigate abuse, perform maintenance, comply with law, or respond to provider outages.

10. Intellectual property

The MydreamShoots website, brand, software, templates, interface, package structure, and documentation belong to MydreamShoots or its licensors. Customer uploads remain subject to the rights of the customer or original owner. Your rights in generated outputs may depend on law, provider rules, your uploaded materials, and the way you use the results.

11. Disclaimers

MydreamShoots is provided as an AI photo software service. Outputs may contain errors, artifacts, inaccurate details, or unexpected results. You should not rely on generated images as official identity documents, professional credentials, legal evidence, or factual records.

12. Limitation of liability

To the fullest extent permitted by law, MydreamShoots is not liable for indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages. Our total liability for a claim is limited to the amount you paid for the affected billing period, subscription, or credit purchase.

13. Changes to these terms

We may update these terms as the service changes. Continued use of MydreamShoots after changes means you accept the updated terms.

14. Contact

Email support@mydreamshoots.com for account, billing, refund, policy, or legal questions.

settings.question: Can I try MydreamShoots for free?
settings.answer: Some lightweight tools can be free, but private model creation and premium packs require a paid plan because they consume dedicated generation credits.

settings.question: What photos should I upload?
settings.answer: Recent, clear, high-quality phone photos work best. Use different angles, expressions, lighting, and outfits so the private model has enough visual range.

settings.question: Are my uploads private?
settings.answer: Yes. Uploads, jobs, albums, orders, and credits are scoped to the private account and the current customer account.

settings.question: What is the refund policy?
settings.answer: Unused credits can be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits that have already been spent on successful generations are not refundable.

settings.question: How do credits work?
settings.answer: Monthly plans grant credits to the customer account. Creating a package reserves the needed credits first, successful results consume them, and failed requests can return them.

settings.question: Why do premium packs need a private model?
settings.answer: A private model keeps the customer's face and style consistent across different photo packages. Simple utility tools can run without it, but premium albums need that model for better continuity.

settings.question: What happens if I cancel a plan?
settings.answer: The account can keep access to previous albums and any credit rules configured for the site. New package requests can be blocked if the subscription is not active.
