settings.title: Privacy policy
settings.body:
1. Information we collect

We collect the email address used for your account, source photos you upload, generation settings, payment status, credit movements, and delivered outputs needed to operate the service.

2. How we use data

We use your data to create AI photo packages, manage credits and subscriptions, deliver private galleries, provide support, prevent abuse, and improve product reliability.

3. Photo privacy

Uploads and generated images stay tied to the signed-in customer account. We do not sell personal photos, and account data is kept private from other customers.

4. Payments

Payments are processed by Stripe or the connected payment account for this photo workspace. We store billing status, order references, and credit movements, not full card numbers.

5. Security

The service is served over HTTPS. Access to private albums, customer assets, jobs, and billing records is scoped by site and customer session.

6. Retention and deletion

You may request deletion of uploaded assets or generated outputs. Some billing, credit history, and abuse-prevention records may be retained where legally or operationally required.

7. Contact

Email support@mydreamshoots.com for privacy, account, or deletion requests.

settings.title: Refund policy
settings.body:
Refund eligibility

You may request a refund for purchased credits if none of the credits from that purchase have been used. Once credits have been spent on a successful generation, that purchase becomes non-refundable.

Refund window

Refund requests should be submitted within 30 days of the purchase date with your account email and purchase details.

Subscriptions

If a subscription is canceled, the customer keeps access to purchased credits until they are used or expire according to the plan rules. Cancellation does not automatically refund credits already used.

Technical failures

If a technical failure on our side prevents credit use or delivery, support may release credits, rerun the job, or approve a refund after review.

Credit history

Refunds and billing reversals are recorded against this photo workspace. Checkout completion never grants credits before payment confirmation, and every adjustment is written through the credit history.

settings.title: Terms of Service
settings.body:
1. Acceptance

By using this site, you agree to these terms and to the privacy policy that governs uploads, generated outputs, purchases, and private delivery.

2. Accounts

Customers must provide accurate account information and keep credentials secure. Each account belongs to the photo workspace and cannot be shared across unrelated site customer records.

3. Subscriptions and credits

Subscriptions and one-time credit packs provide credits for AI photo generation. Credits are granted after confirmed payment, reserved when a job starts, consumed after successful delivery, and released when a job fails or times out.

4. Refunds

Unused credits may be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits already spent on successful generations are not refundable unless support confirms a service-side technical failure.

5. Uploaded content

You may only upload images and references you control or have permission to use. The site may reject, review, remove, or block content that violates law, platform rules, or safety policy.

6. Delivery

Completed jobs are delivered to the signed-in customer account. Delivery states, retries, credit releases, and refunds are handled by the backend and recorded in your credit history.

7. Liability

The service is provided as a software subscription. To the extent permitted by law, liability is limited to the fees paid for the current billing period or the affected credit purchase.

8. Contact us

Email support@mydreamshoots.com for account, billing, refund, or policy questions.

settings.question: Can I try Aidreamcapes for free?
settings.answer: Some lightweight tools can be free, but private model creation and premium packs require a paid plan because they consume dedicated generation credits.

settings.question: What photos should I upload?
settings.answer: Recent, clear, high-quality phone photos work best. Use different angles, expressions, lighting, and outfits so the private model has enough visual range.

settings.question: Are my uploads private?
settings.answer: Yes. Source photos, generation jobs, albums, orders, and credits stay connected to your signed-in Aidreamcapes account and are not public by default.

settings.question: What is the refund policy?
settings.answer: Unused credits can be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits that have already been spent on successful generations are not refundable.

settings.question: How do credits work?
settings.answer: Monthly plans grant credits to the customer account. Creating a package reserves the needed credits first, successful results consume them, and failed requests can return them.

settings.question: Why do premium packs need a private model?
settings.answer: A private model keeps the customer's face and style consistent across different dreamscape packages. Simple utility tools can run without it, but premium albums need that model for better continuity.

settings.question: What happens if I cancel a plan?
settings.answer: The account can keep access to previous albums and any credit rules configured for the site. New package requests can be blocked if the subscription is not active.

settings.title: How Aidreamcapes handles your photo and account data.
settings.body: This policy is written for Aidreamcapes customers using www.aidreamcapes.com, our AI photo package tools, credits, and private album delivery.

settings.title: Privacy policy
settings.body:
1. Information we collect

We collect account email, source photos, generation settings, credit movements, payment status, and delivered outputs needed to operate Aidreamcapes.

2. How we use data

We use this data to create private dreamscape portraits, manage credits, deliver galleries, provide support, prevent abuse, and improve reliability.

3. Photo privacy

Uploads and generated images stay tied to the current site and customer account. We do not sell personal photos.

4. Payments

Payments are processed by the connected payment provider. We store billing state and ledger records, not full card numbers.

5. Contact

Email support@aidreamcapes.com for privacy, account, or deletion requests.

settings.title: Privacy
settings.body: Photo, account, and billing-data practices for Aidreamcapes customers.

settings.title: Refund policy
settings.body:
Refund eligibility

You may request a refund for purchased credits if none of the credits from that purchase have been used.

Technical failures

If a service-side failure prevents generation or delivery, support may release credits, rerun the request, or review a refund.

Subscriptions

Canceling a subscription stops future renewal. Credits already spent on successful generations are not refundable.

seo.description: Understand refund eligibility for unused credits, failed AI photo generation jobs, subscriptions, top-ups, and private album delivery issues.

settings.title: Terms for using Aidreamcapes dreamscape packages, credits, and albums.
settings.body: These terms apply when you use www.aidreamcapes.com, create an account, buy credits, start AI photo jobs, or access private generated albums.

settings.title: Terms of Service
settings.body:
1. Acceptance

By using Aidreamcapes, you agree to these terms and the privacy policy.

2. Accounts

Customers must provide accurate account information and keep credentials secure.

3. Credits and delivery

Credits are granted after confirmed payment, reserved when a request starts, consumed after successful delivery, and released when a request fails or times out.

4. Uploaded content

You may only upload images and references you control or have permission to use.

5. Contact

Email support@aidreamcapes.com for account, billing, or policy questions.

settings.title: Terms
settings.body: Service terms for Aidreamcapes customers.

settings.title: Content policy
settings.body:
1. Upload rights

You may upload only photos, references, logos, outfits, products, or other materials that you own or have permission to use. Aidreamcapes is designed for personal AI headshots, creator portraits, fan photos, beauty edits, travel scenes, and private albums, not unauthorized use of another person's likeness or copyrighted material.

2. Identity and consent

Do not upload images of people who have not given you permission, and do not use Aidreamcapes to impersonate private individuals, public figures, coworkers, classmates, customers, or creators. Premium portrait packages should represent you or people who have clearly agreed to the generation.

3. Prohibited content

We may block, remove, or refuse content involving sexual exploitation, minors in unsafe contexts, harassment, hate, fraud, violence, illegal activity, explicit non-consensual imagery, sensitive personal data, or attempts to bypass safety systems.

4. Brands, teams, and protected marks

Sports fan photos, creator scenes, product-style images, and themed packs should avoid unauthorized team logos, official marks, celebrity likenesses, and brand assets unless you have permission. Use descriptive styling rather than pretending to be endorsed by a brand, league, team, or person.

5. Output review

AI outputs can vary. Aidreamcapes may moderate, rerun, remove, or restrict delivery of generated images that violate policy, create safety risk, or appear to misuse identity, intellectual property, or private information.

6. Questions

Email support@aidreamcapes.com if you are unsure whether a source photo, reference, or requested style is allowed.

settings.title: How cookies support sign-in, checkout, and private albums.
settings.body: This policy explains the cookies and local storage used on www.aidreamcapes.com for the Aidreamcapes AI photo service.

settings.title: Cookie policy
settings.body:
1. What cookies are

Cookies are small files stored by your browser. Aidreamcapes also uses similar browser storage, such as local storage, to keep the AI photo service secure, usable, and consistent while you move between packages, checkout, your account, and private albums.

2. Essential cookies

Essential cookies support customer sign-in, scoped sessions, CSRF protection, checkout continuity, credit reservation flows, private album access, rate limiting, fraud prevention, and secure admin or customer authentication. These cookies are required for the core service and cannot be switched off inside the site without breaking key features.

3. Preference storage

We may remember practical preferences such as menu state, recently opened workspace views, selected package context, language or display choices if available, and browser-side UI settings. This helps Aidreamcapes open the right customer workspace more quickly.

4. Performance and diagnostics

We may collect limited technical signals to understand slow pages, failed requests, broken checkout steps, job submission errors, and account access issues. These signals help us improve route speed, generation reliability, and customer support.

5. Analytics and measurement

If analytics tools are enabled, they may help us understand aggregated usage such as popular package categories, tool discovery, pricing page visits, and conversion paths. Analytics should not be used to sell your uploaded photos or generated images.

6. Payment, email, hosting, and AI providers

Connected providers may set or read cookies or similar identifiers when needed for checkout, anti-fraud checks, email delivery, hosting security, media storage, or AI generation. Their use is limited to providing and protecting the requested service.

7. Your browser controls

You can block, delete, or limit cookies in your browser settings. If you block essential cookies, Aidreamcapes may not be able to keep you signed in, complete checkout, reserve credits, start generation jobs, or open private albums.

8. Relationship to privacy policy

Cookie data is handled together with the privacy practices described in our Privacy Policy. The Terms of Service explain customer responsibilities when using accounts, credits, uploads, and generated outputs.

9. Updates and contact

We may update this Cookie Policy as we add or remove providers, analytics, checkout methods, or security features. Email support@aidreamcapes.com with cookie or tracking questions.

settings.question: Can I try Aidreamcapes for free?
settings.answer: Some lightweight tools can be free, but private model creation and premium packs require a paid plan because they consume dedicated generation credits.

settings.question: What photos should I upload?
settings.answer: Recent, clear, high-quality phone photos work best. Use different angles, expressions, lighting, and outfits so the private model has enough visual range.

settings.question: Are my uploads private?
settings.answer: Yes. Source photos, generation jobs, albums, orders, and credits stay connected to your signed-in Aidreamcapes account and are not public by default.

settings.question: What is the refund policy?
settings.answer: Unused credits can be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits that have already been spent on successful generations are not refundable.

settings.question: How do credits work?
settings.answer: Monthly plans grant credits to the customer account. Creating a package reserves the needed credits first, successful results consume them, and failed requests can return them.

settings.question: Why do premium packs need a private model?
settings.answer: A private model keeps the customer's face and style consistent across different dreamscape packages. Simple utility tools can run without it, but premium albums need that model for better continuity.

settings.question: What happens if I cancel a plan?
settings.answer: The account can keep access to previous albums and any credit rules configured for the site. New package requests can be blocked if the subscription is not active.

settings.title: How Aidreamcapes handles your photo and account data.
settings.body: This policy is written for Aidreamcapes customers using www.aidreamcapes.com, our AI photo package tools, credits, and private album delivery.

settings.title: Privacy policy
settings.body:
1. Information we collect

We collect account email, source photos, generation settings, credit movements, payment status, and delivered outputs needed to operate Aidreamcapes.

2. How we use data

We use this data to create private dreamscape portraits, manage credits, deliver galleries, provide support, prevent abuse, and improve reliability.

3. Photo privacy

Uploads and generated images stay tied to the current site and customer account. We do not sell personal photos.

4. Payments

Payments are processed by the connected payment provider. We store billing state and ledger records, not full card numbers.

5. Contact

Email support@aidreamcapes.com for privacy, account, or deletion requests.

settings.title: Privacy
settings.body: Photo, account, and billing-data practices for Aidreamcapes customers.

settings.title: Refund policy
settings.body:
Refund eligibility

You may request a refund for purchased credits if none of the credits from that purchase have been used.

Technical failures

If a service-side failure prevents generation or delivery, support may release credits, rerun the request, or review a refund.

Subscriptions

Canceling a subscription stops future renewal. Credits already spent on successful generations are not refundable.

settings.title: Terms for using Aidreamcapes dreamscape packages, credits, and albums.
settings.body: These terms apply when you use www.aidreamcapes.com, create an account, buy credits, start AI photo jobs, or access private generated albums.

settings.title: Terms of Service
settings.body:
1. Acceptance

By using Aidreamcapes, you agree to these terms and the privacy policy.

2. Accounts

Customers must provide accurate account information and keep credentials secure.

3. Credits and delivery

Credits are granted after confirmed payment, reserved when a request starts, consumed after successful delivery, and released when a request fails or times out.

4. Uploaded content

You may only upload images and references you control or have permission to use.

5. Contact

Email support@aidreamcapes.com for account, billing, or policy questions.

settings.title: Terms
settings.body: Service terms for Aidreamcapes customers.

settings.title: Content policy
settings.body:
1. Upload rights

You may upload only photos, references, logos, outfits, products, or other materials that you own or have permission to use. Aidreamcapes is designed for personal AI headshots, creator portraits, fan photos, beauty edits, travel scenes, and private albums, not unauthorized use of another person's likeness or copyrighted material.

2. Identity and consent

Do not upload images of people who have not given you permission, and do not use Aidreamcapes to impersonate private individuals, public figures, coworkers, classmates, customers, or creators. Premium portrait packages should represent you or people who have clearly agreed to the generation.

3. Prohibited content

We may block, remove, or refuse content involving sexual exploitation, minors in unsafe contexts, harassment, hate, fraud, violence, illegal activity, explicit non-consensual imagery, sensitive personal data, or attempts to bypass safety systems.

4. Brands, teams, and protected marks

Sports fan photos, creator scenes, product-style images, and themed packs should avoid unauthorized team logos, official marks, celebrity likenesses, and brand assets unless you have permission. Use descriptive styling rather than pretending to be endorsed by a brand, league, team, or person.

5. Output review

AI outputs can vary. Aidreamcapes may moderate, rerun, remove, or restrict delivery of generated images that violate policy, create safety risk, or appear to misuse identity, intellectual property, or private information.

6. Questions

Email support@aidreamcapes.com if you are unsure whether a source photo, reference, or requested style is allowed.

settings.title: How cookies support sign-in, checkout, and private albums.
settings.body: This policy explains the cookies and local storage used on www.aidreamcapes.com for the Aidreamcapes AI photo service.

settings.title: Cookie policy
settings.body:
1. What cookies are

Cookies are small files stored by your browser. Aidreamcapes also uses similar browser storage, such as local storage, to keep the AI photo service secure, usable, and consistent while you move between packages, checkout, your account, and private albums.

2. Essential cookies

Essential cookies support customer sign-in, scoped sessions, CSRF protection, checkout continuity, credit reservation flows, private album access, rate limiting, fraud prevention, and secure admin or customer authentication. These cookies are required for the core service and cannot be switched off inside the site without breaking key features.

3. Preference storage

We may remember practical preferences such as menu state, recently opened workspace views, selected package context, language or display choices if available, and browser-side UI settings. This helps Aidreamcapes open the right customer workspace more quickly.

4. Performance and diagnostics

We may collect limited technical signals to understand slow pages, failed requests, broken checkout steps, job submission errors, and account access issues. These signals help us improve route speed, generation reliability, and customer support.

5. Analytics and measurement

If analytics tools are enabled, they may help us understand aggregated usage such as popular package categories, tool discovery, pricing page visits, and conversion paths. Analytics should not be used to sell your uploaded photos or generated images.

6. Payment, email, hosting, and AI providers

Connected providers may set or read cookies or similar identifiers when needed for checkout, anti-fraud checks, email delivery, hosting security, media storage, or AI generation. Their use is limited to providing and protecting the requested service.

7. Your browser controls

You can block, delete, or limit cookies in your browser settings. If you block essential cookies, Aidreamcapes may not be able to keep you signed in, complete checkout, reserve credits, start generation jobs, or open private albums.

8. Relationship to privacy policy

Cookie data is handled together with the privacy practices described in our Privacy Policy. The Terms of Service explain customer responsibilities when using accounts, credits, uploads, and generated outputs.

9. Updates and contact

We may update this Cookie Policy as we add or remove providers, analytics, checkout methods, or security features. Email support@aidreamcapes.com with cookie or tracking questions.

settings.question: Can I try Aidreamcapes for free?
settings.answer: Some lightweight tools can be free, but private model creation and premium packs require a paid plan because they consume dedicated generation credits.

settings.question: What photos should I upload?
settings.answer: Recent, clear, high-quality phone photos work best. Use different angles, expressions, lighting, and outfits so the private model has enough visual range.

settings.question: Are my uploads private?
settings.answer: Yes. Source photos, generation jobs, albums, orders, and credits stay connected to your signed-in Aidreamcapes account and are not public by default.

settings.question: What is the refund policy?
settings.answer: Unused credits can be reviewed for refund eligibility within 30 days. Credits that have already been spent on successful generations are not refundable.

settings.question: How do credits work?
settings.answer: Monthly plans grant credits to the customer account. Creating a package reserves the needed credits first, successful results consume them, and failed requests can return them.

settings.question: Why do premium packs need a private model?
settings.answer: A private model keeps the customer's face and style consistent across different dreamscape packages. Simple utility tools can run without it, but premium albums need that model for better continuity.

settings.question: What happens if I cancel a plan?
settings.answer: The account can keep access to previous albums and any credit rules configured for the site. New package requests can be blocked if the subscription is not active.

settings.title: How to prepare source photos for better AI headshots and portraits
settings.body: Strong AI photo results start before generation. Use recent, high-resolution source photos with natural light, varied angles, different expressions, and clean backgrounds. Avoid heavy filters, sunglasses, extreme crops, and group photos when you want consistent headshots or creator portraits.
